content_of_post_to_comment: I have a confession. I’ve been carrying around a couple of book manuscripts for far too long. One of them asks whether we ever really become “finished” at all. So… I just joined Kristina God and Fleur Hull’s Online Writing Club. Consider this my public declaration that at least one of these books will make it into the world. Wish me luck. (And maybe hold me accountable.) Kristina God, MBA Fleur Hull
